thread: The model got bigger and the harness got sturdier in the same week. Atlas-3 ships a 400K-token context window, and Parcel 2.0 resumes crashed runs from their last completed step. Both lower the cost of a long task failing late.

items.headline: Atlas-3 posts new SWE-Verify and Terminal-Ops scores
items.why: Atlas-3 scores 58.4% on SWE-Verify and ships with a 400K-token context window, available from today in the API.
items.connection: Read with the Parcel change: the model can hold more, and the harness can survive more.

items.headline: Parcel 2.0 adds durable execution
items.why: Parcel 2.0 adds durable execution, so a crashed run resumes from its last completed step. Steps are checkpointed to a Postgres table, and retries use exponential backoff capped at five attempts.
items.connection: If your agent loop restarts from zero today, this is the cheapest reliability win on the list.
